note: THE PARENT ARGUMENT, and the behaviour it buys. Emacs answers ((u0-e3 u0-e2 error) (parent u0-e3 (1))): the child's conditions are its own symbol CONSED ONTO THE PARENT'S LIST -- read at define time, not chased at signal time -- and a `condition-case' naming the PARENT catches the child, with the condition object still carrying the child's own symbol and data. That last point is the one a handler depends on. kg answers `void-function' at this pin.
